question: Kumkum Mohanty, an Odissi dancer received which of the following awards in 2005?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma **__**__Shri. __**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__****

__
 
• Sonal Mansingh, a Bharatanatyam and Odissi dance master, was born on **April 30, 1944**, in India.
 
• She has received the President of India's nomination to serve in the **Rajya Sabha**.
 
• She received the **Padma Bhushan in 1992** and the** Padma Vibhushan in 2003 **as the youngest recipient.
 
• **Kelucharan Mohapatra**, a renowned Indian classical dancer, master, and exponent of **Odissi dance**, lived from 8 January 1926 to 7 April 2004.
 
• He is credited with bringing back and making popular this ancient dance style in the 20th century.
 
• He is the** first** recipient of Odisha's Padma Vibhushan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Cuttack is where **Mohanty **was born. In Kala Vikash Kendra, she received instruction from** Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra.**
 
• She is well known for her **abhinaya**.
 
• She previously served as the **Government of Odisha's special secretary for culture**.
 
• At Bhubaneshwar, she opened her dancing studio, **Geeta Govinda**, in 2006, following her retirement in 2004.
 
• Without regard to race, occupation, status, or sex, the medal is granted for "distinguished service of a high order."
 
• Doctors and scientists are included in the award criteria, along with "service in any field, including service performed by **Government servants**," although individuals employed by **public sector firms **are not.
 
• **Padma Bhushan: **
 
 
• **​**The Bharat Ratna, the Padma Vibhushan, and the Padma Shri are the two highest civilian honours of the **Republic of India**, with the** Padma Bhushan** coming in** third**.
 
• Awarded for "distinguished service of a high order...without difference of race, occupation, status, or sex," the award was established on **January 2, 1954**.
 
• Doctors and scientists are included in the award criteria, along with "service in any field, including service performed by Government servants," although individuals employed by **public sector firms** are not.
 
• By the year** 2020,** **1270 **people had received the honour, including **24 posthumous and 97 non-citizen honorees**.
 
 
 
• **Kalidas Samman:**
 
 
• The Indian state of **Madhya Pradesh** annually bestows the Kalidas Samman, a **prize for the arts**. 
 
• The honour bears Klidsa's name, a well-known author of **Classical Sanskrit** in prehistoric India. 
 
• In **1980**,** **the Kalidas Samman was first given out. Classical Music, Classical Dance, Theatre, and Plastic Arts were the first four disciplines in which it was awarded on an annual basis.
 
• From 1986–87 to 2008–09, the prizes were typically given out in all four categories.
 
• After that, it was just one recipient per year.
 
 
 
• **Padma Vibhushan:**
 
 
• ​After the Bharat Ratna, the Padma Vibhushan ("**Lotus Decoration**") is the Republic of India's **second-highest civilian honour**. Instituted on 2 January 1954, the medal is granted for "exceptional and outstanding service".
 
• All people, regardless of **ethnicity, profession, status, or sexual orientation,** are eligible for these honours.
 
• Government employees, including those employed by** PSUs**, are not eligible for these Prizes, with the exception of physicians and scientists.
 
• By the year** 2022**, **325 people** had received the honour, including **19 posthumous and 21 non-citizen honorees**.
